text.librarian_filter.success_enchantmen: §a[Librarian Filter] Updated trade to: %s %s (%s Emeralds - Lowest Price)
text.librarian_filter.not_found: §c[Librarian Filter] No matching item or trade found for: %s
text.librarian_filter.not_found_enchantm: §c[Librarian Filter] No matching enchantment or trade found for: %s
text.librarian_filter.cannot_offer_books: §c[Librarian Filter] %s cannot offer enchanted books. Workstation must be a Lectern.
text.librarian_filter.no_trades_for_item: §c[Librarian Filter] %s has no trades for item: %s
text.librarian_filter.already_traded: §c[Librarian Filter] Villager has already been traded with at their current level.
text.librarian_filter.no_villager: §c[Librarian Filter] No villager found with this workstation as their job station.
text.librarian_filter.update_failed: §c[Librarian Filter] Failed to update villager trades.

text.librarian_filter.setup_complete: §aSetup complete! Spawned an enclosed villager facing workstation with sign ["%s"]. Right-click workstation to reroll trade!
text.librarian_filter.help: §a[Librarian Filter] Use §e/reroll setup§a to spawn a trapped villager booth, §e/reroll list§a for books, or §e/reroll find <enchantment>§a to locate villagers.
